title: “Unguzhol – zaman talaba”：BMUda uluttuk ideany chagyldyrgan kitep zharyk kordu

blocks.text: 2025-zhyldyn 6 月 19 日，院士 K. Karasaev 在比什凯克 mamlekettik 大学“Uluttuk dem – duinoluk biyiktik”unguzholunun alkagynda“Unguzhol – zaman talaby”attuu ilimiya-methodikalyk kiteptin bet achar azemi bolup שтть。布尔埃姆格大学在奥库穆什图拉里塔拉拜南达亚达利普，扎尔利克塔贝尔吉伦根巴吉塔迪伊什克阿什鲁加巴吉塔尔甘。

Ish-charaga mamlekettik katchy Marat Imankulov，总统府奥库卢，tarykh ilimderinin 医生 Oktyabr Kapalbaev，Uluttuk Ilimder Akademiasynin 副院长，Cholponkul Arabaev 院士，belgiluu okumushtuular – Sulaiman Kaiypov 教授，Kyas Moldokasimov，oshondoy ele 大学教授duk-okutuuchuluk kurama zhana 学生Katyshty。

Kitepte“Uluttuk dem – duynoluk biyiktik”unguzholunda karalgan mamlekettik til，uluttuk tarykh，吉尔吉斯哲学，民族教育学zana生态学syyaktuu negizgi侵权bagyt ilimiy negizde taldanyp berylet。作者 lordun aitymynda、globaldashuu shartynda uluttuk שzgשchשlйktіrbׯzdu — tilibizdi、madaniyatybyzdy、kaada-salttarybyzdy saktoo zhana onukturhuu koom aldyndagy maaniluu milet。 Bul kitep dal ushul maksatta zhazylyp, uluttuk baaluuluktarybyzdy duinoluk dengeelde taanytuuga salym koshot。
